acceptanceCriteria: Costs are regenerated from retained hosted go test -json package outcomes by a checked-in tool, with the source run recorded.
A drift check reports when an observed package time differs from its table entry by more than a stated factor or a package is missing.
Full mode still runs every package exactly once; an invalid or missing weight keeps the existing complete fallback.
body: Observed 2026-10-04 during a CI audit (Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, Tasks build 202) at origin/main e5d47da8; hosted run https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/actions/runs/37198363933 (4 shards, 295 packages, 5635s summed package time, race steps 1924/1647/1397/1264s). Confirmed: .github/cishards/package-costs.json (last changed 960ee04c, 2026-10-01) has 253 entries for 295 packages. internal/testacceptance is recorded as 3220ms and ran 953.5s; internal/behaviorfalsify is recorded 910s and ran 98s; internal/doccorpus/selfcorpus (144s) and internal/postmergeworkflow (44s) are missing. Observed shard test sums 1706/1544/1135/1248s against an ideal 1409s; other runs the same day reached 2204s on one shard. The table is hand-maintained and under .github/, so every refresh needs an admin control-plane acceptance. Related: V1-0617 (balancing, delivered by PR 425).
title: ci: shard cost table is stale (testacceptance 3s recorded, 953s observed) and has no refresh path
